svg.title: Estimated CPU cost to empirical checkpoint for dimensions 1 to 10
svg.desc: Comparative results from Mac Jupyter screenshots, original explicit implementations, five Markov walks, Python and C++. 2560-step budget, 3000 chains, seed 2026. The checkpoint criterion is empirical and does not certify total variation mixing.
svg.text: Original explicit implementations · n = 1,…,10 · 3,000 chains · seed 2026
Vertical scales are logarithmic and differ by panel. Cost = 3,000 × checkpoint × μs/transition ÷ 10⁶.
Source: results/reported_mac_results/n1_to_n10_transcribed.csv · Values transcribed from Mac Jupyter screenshots · One run
